risks.risk: Engine model/variant mismatch (wrong engine family for the RAV4 XA20 or wrong displacement/variant), which changes parts fit and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code/ID stamped on the block (and/or the label/plate) plus the full engine number; also a photo of the transmission bellhousing mating side to confirm mating pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used Toyota engine assembly with unknown variant/fit risk (worst-case: may require additional parts or may not bolt up cleanly).

risks.risk: Not truly 'complete' for installation (missing key components like starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness sections, mounts, timing components, or coolant/oil lines).
risks.proof: A photo checklist laid out on the floor showing every included part (starter, alternator, intake/throttle body, alternator bracket, sensors, engine mounts, timing cover/tensioner status, etc.) and what is not included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed complete; assume missing/extra-cost items may be needed.

risks.risk: Internal condition not proven (possible bearing noise/knock, low compression, oil leaks, head gasket issues).
risks.proof: Video of the engine running from cold start (showing idle stability) + compression test results (all cylinders) or leak-down test results.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needing inspection/possible repairs).

risks.risk: Mileage claim may be inaccurate; 'never opened' may be false (tamper marks, resealed gaskets, replaced timing components).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of gasket seams and timing cover area for tamper/reseal marks, plus receipts/inspection report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown mileage/unknown whether opened (worst-case: assume it may have been serviced or has wear).

risks.risk: Compatibility with your exact RAV4 (engine code + ECU/immobilizer setup) not confirmed.
risks.proof: Your vehicle details (VIN or engine code) matched against the engine’s stamped code; photo of ECU/immobilizer components if included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring additional matching work (worst-case: ECU/immobilizer or sensor mismatch).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID stamped on the block (and the readable label/plate).
Video of the engine running (preferably cold start) showing no knock and stable idle.
Compression test (or leak-down) results with cylinder-by-cylinder numbers.
Photos showing exactly what is included to qualify as 'complete' (lay-out of parts) and what is missing.
response.reason: The photos show a Toyota engine assembly, but the engine code/variant and completeness are not readable/confirmable, and the 'tested and working/no knock/low mileage/never opened' claims are not proven by any running video or test results. Without the engine ID and proof of condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
